4.strategy_description: This strategy combines quality-aware and latency-first approaches. For each node, it first selects the execution profile with the highest normalized quality lower confidence bound, then chooses the lowest-energy compatible device for that configuration. If no quality-optimized profile exists, it defaults to the fastest execution profile based on warm p95 latency. This hybrid approach balances accuracy and performance while ensuring feasibility.

5.strategy_description: The hybrid strategy prioritizes quality by selecting the highest normalized quality lower confidence bound configuration, then chooses the lowest-energy compatible device. If no quality-optimized profile exists, it defaults to the fastest execution profile based on latency. This approach balances performance and energy efficiency while ensuring feasibility.

6.strategy_description: For each DAG node, prioritize execution profiles with the highest normalized quality lower confidence bound (LCB), then select the lowest-energy compatible device. If no quality-optimized profile exists, fall back to the fastest profile based on warm p95 latency. This balances accuracy and latency while ensuring compatibility and energy efficiency.
